topic: Switching to a free checking account to kill monthly bank fees (Sawyer vs Fenna)

scenes.narration: Some banks quietly charge fifteen dollars monthly just to hold your own money. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym pointing at a giant bank statement, comic burst banner reads FIFTEEN A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Sawyer and Fenna both bank at the same big branch.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man sawyer and woman fenna in gym gear at a bank counter labeled BIG BRANCH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each pays a twelve dollar monthly account maintenance fee quietly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two bank statements on a gym bench each highlighting a line stamped TWELVE DOLLAR FEE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Sawyer ignores the fee, calling twelve dollars no big deal.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, sawyer waving off a statement on a gym mat, comic banner reads NO BIG DEAL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He also overdrafts twice, adding seventy more dollars in penalties.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, sawyer wincing at a phone alert by a gym locker stamped OVERDRAFT SEVENTY DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Fenna compares banks and finds a free online checking account.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, fenna on a gym mat with a laptop, a wall chart labeled FREE CHECKING NO FEES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Zero monthly fee, no minimum balance, and free overdraft protection.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, fenna holding a new account card near a gym bench, checklist stamped ZERO FEE NO MINIMUM FREE PROTECTION, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She moves her paycheck and bills to the new account.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, fenna tapping a phone in the gym, arrows moving PAYCHECK and BILLS to a card labeled NEW ACCOUNT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One year later Sawyer lost two hundred fifty in fees.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked sawyer on a gym bench holding fee receipts stamped TWO HUNDRED FIFTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Fenna paid exactly zero dollars in banking fees all year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, fenna flexing in the gym holding a clean statement stamped ZERO FEES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She even earned a little interest instead of feeding the bank.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, fenna watching a small rising chart on a gym wall labeled INTEREST EARNED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Never pay to store your money; switch to free checking. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle in the gym holding a clipboard reading FREE CHECKING, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
